description: Get recent notes/context for the site. Recommended before creating tweets/posts.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

limit.description: How many recent notes to return. Defaults to 5, capped at 20.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

name: get_recent_notes
title: Get Recent Notes
